meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 对着 Dieter Rams 十条原则逐条审查设计,每条打 0–3 分并附证据,汇总出一个结论(NEW / REFINE / REDESIGN),最后产出可直接粘贴运行的 /make-plan 提示词,文件写入 DESIGN-IS-日期/ 目录。
howto.when: 当你说「audit this design」「design review」「check this UI against Rams」等,或要求一次最终能导向计划的点评时触发。常规 UI 代码审查、纯文案修改不适用。

say.text: 对照 Rams 十条原则审查这个页面并逐条打分
say.note: 产出计分卡和结论,存进 DESIGN-IS 目录

say.text: 评审这个登录页,给出 5 个最该改的点
say.note: 每条改动都绑定原则和证据出处

say.text: 设计还没做出来,直接给我 NEW 的 /make-plan 提示词
say.note: 跳过取证阶段,输出从零开始的计划提示词

howto.what_en: Audits a design against Dieter Rams' ten principles, scores each 0–3 with cited evidence, writes a NEW/REFINE/REDESIGN verdict, and outputs a ready-to-run /make-plan prompt in DESIGN-IS-<date>/.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", or any critique meant to lead to a plan. Not for routine UI code reviews or copy-only edits.

say_en.text: Audit this page against Rams' ten principles and score it.
say_en.note: Writes scorecard and verdict to DESIGN-IS-<date>/

say_en.text: Critique this login screen and give the top 5 highest-leverage fixes.
say_en.note: Ties each fix to a principle and evidence anchor

say_en.text: No design yet — just give me the NEW /make-plan prompt.
say_en.note: Skips evidence phases, emits a from-scratch plan prompt
